item.title: Sepp Straka part of 4-way tie at the top at The Players Championship in wild weather
item.description: Sepp Straka saved par seven times and chipped in for eagle late in his roundThursday while avoiding big trouble on the TPC Sawgrass for a 5-under 67 that gave him a share of the lead at The Players Championship amid wind, rain, sunshine and darkness. The post Sepp Straka part of 4-way tie at the top at The Players Championship in wild weather appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Commission settles jail excessive force case for $475,000
item.description: The Augusta Commission agreed to settle an excessive force lawsuit Tuesday that accused five Richmond County Sheriff’s deputies of severely injuring an inmate. The post Commission settles jail excessive force case for $475,000 appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Two years of conflict led up to Beech Island stabbing, reports show
item.description: Newly released reports from the Aiken County Sheriff’s Office reveal a long and increasingly hostile history between the family of a Beech Island man who was fatally stabbed and the career criminal who investigators say acted in self-defense. The post Two years of conflict led up to Beech Island stabbing, reports show appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Former Taliaferro County sheriff arrested in McDuffie County on felony charge
item.description: Former Taliaferro County Sheriff Marc Richards was arrested Wednesday in McDuffie County on charges of felony aggravated assault and misdemeanor battery. The post Former Taliaferro County sheriff arrested in McDuffie County on felony charge appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Georgia lawmakers debate legalizing silencers as gun safety bills stall
item.description: Georgia has some of the loosest gun laws in the nation, but a bill to remove the state’s restriction on silencers tested lawmakers’ limits. The post Georgia lawmakers debate legalizing silencers as gun safety bills stall appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Waste Management seeks to reopen former waste transfer station
item.description: Georgia Waste Systems, the Augusta division of Waste Management, is planning to use its Goshen Industrial Boulevard property as a transfer station again, according to a request submitted to Richmond County in December.
